mentions.name: Video Notes
mentions.description: A browser extension that lets users take notes directly on YouTube videos. It is open source, works offline, and stores all notes locally; note export is available via the extension icon's gear menu.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a very simple browser extension that allows you to take notes right on youtube. It is open source, offline and everything is locally stored.
